HOW ZIMRA AFFECTS THIS PLATFORM - FOR PIN TAIL TRADING VAT 220188421:

1. PLATFORM DOES NOT REPLACE YOUR FISCAL DEVICE:
- Your fiscal device 38468 at 68 Fife Street STILL prints fiscal receipt as normal when customer collects at counter. Platform is ORDERING system, not fiscal printer.

2. YOUR PROCESS (Compliant with ZIMRA):
- Customer pays EcoCash to your account (ZiG210 - Code MP2408...)
- Customer comes to 68 Fife St counter with Code + ID
- You verify Code on *151# + Check Geo (Bulawayo/Gwanda/Plumtree/Gokwe)
- You ENTER sale on your fiscal device 38468 - Print fiscal receipt with VAT
- Give customer fiscal receipt + goods - Customer collects
- Your ZIMRA submissions continue as before - No change

3. WHAT PLATFORM DOES FOR ZIMRA:
- Records all orders with EcoCash codes for your accountant
- Export Excel: Date, Order, Amount, Code, VAT split (15% VAT)
- Helps reconcile EcoCash income vs fiscal receipts - Audit trail
- Shows ZiG vs USD split - Required for ZIMRA QPD

4. VAT CALCULATION (VAT 220188421):
- Example: Customer pays ZiG210 for Boom Powder
- Your fiscal device splits: Net ZiG182.61 + VAT ZiG27.39 (15%)
- Platform shows gross, you do fiscal split at counter
- VAT collected goes to ZIMRA via your normal process

5. NO EXTRA ZIMRA REGISTRATION NEEDED:
- Platform is classified as marketplace / advertising service - You pay us 10% commission (We handle our own VAT)
- Your sales remain YOUR sales from 68 Fife Street - Already registered - Device 38468
- Commission invoice from ZimGroceries to Pin Tail Trading for accounting
